title.zh: 在延续之下，普查的平衡分两半成立：没有分裂时止息复现需要生起复现，没有合并且计数有界时反之；两者都没有时平衡精确
title.en: Under a continuation the census balance holds in two halves: without splits ceasing recurring needs arising recurring, and without merges under a bounded count conversely; with neither the balance is exact

claim.zh: 普查定律（ceasing-needs-arising、bounded-census-keeps-pace、census-balance）以名字规定的同一读生起与止息：每个形成只延续自身。在任一延续关系 R 下（R t g f 把步后的 f 读作延续步前的 g），形成 f 跨步生起：步后活跃，且不延续任何步前活跃的形成（ArisesFrom）；形成 g 跨步止息：步前活跃，且没有步后活跃的形成延续它（Web.CeasesFrom）；分裂是一个形成延续为两个（NoSplit 排除它），合并是两个延续为一个（Web.NoMerge 排除它）。在普查之下、活动与延续可判定时，每一步上：没有分裂时，步后活跃的连同止息的至多是步前活跃的连同生起的；没有合并时至少如此；两者都没有时恰好相等（Web.Census.balanceFrom、balanceFrom_eq）。证明以跨步延续的配对数为中介：步后被延续的不多于配对数，没有合并时恰是；步前被延续的不多于配对数，没有分裂时恰是（mark_le_total、total_le_mark、total_swap）。每个形成只延续自身时既无分裂也无合并（Web.self_one_to_one），止息与生起即普通的止息与生起（Web.ceasesFrom_self、arisesFrom_self）。每步的不等式跨段累加（le_over_stretch、ge_over_stretch），一个计数每步终点连同失去的不超过起点连同得到的，失去复现就需要得到复现，反向且计数从某步起有界时反之（gaining_of_losing、losing_of_gaining）；所以没有分裂时，止息在任意晚的步出现需要生起在任意晚的步出现（Web.Census.arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom）；没有合并且从某步起至多 B 个活跃时，生起在任意晚的步出现需要止息在任意晚的步出现（Web.Census.ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom）。每个条件都不可少：Tandem 中每步 t 与 t+1 两个形成活跃；读作每个形成只延续自身，每步一个生起、一个止息（Tandem.kept）；读作萌出（较晚的延续为自身与新形成，较早的不被延续），普查成立、没有合并，每步一个止息而从不生起（Tandem.budding）；读作合并（两个都延续为较晚的那个），至多两个活跃、没有分裂，每步一个生起而从不止息（Tandem.joining）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: The census laws (ceasing-needs-arising, bounded-census-keeps-pace, census-balance) read arising and ceasing under the identity the names stipulate: each formation continues only itself. Under any continuation R, where R t g f reads f after the step as continuing g before it, f arises across the step when it is active after it and continues no formation active before it (ArisesFrom), and g ceases across the step when it is active before it and no formation active after it continues it (Web.CeasesFrom); a split is one formation continuing as two (NoSplit excludes it), a merge two continuing as one (Web.NoMerge excludes it). Under a census, with activity and the continuation decided, across each step: without splits, the formations active after the step with those ceasing are at most those active before with those arising; without merges, at least; with neither, exactly (Web.Census.balanceFrom, balanceFrom_eq). The proof goes through the continuing pairs: the formations after the step that are continued are no more than the pairs, exactly as many without merges, and those before it that are continued are no more than the pairs, exactly as many without splits (mark_le_total, total_le_mark, total_swap). Each formation continuing only itself splits none and merges none (Web.self_one_to_one), and ceasing and arising under it are ceasing and arising (Web.ceasesFrom_self, arisesFrom_self). The inequalities across each step add up over any stretch (le_over_stretch, ge_over_stretch): a count ending each step with what it loses at most where it started with what it gains has losses recurring only with gains recurring, and with the inequality the other way and the count bounded from some step on, conversely (gaining_of_losing, losing_of_gaining). So without splits, ceasing at arbitrarily late steps needs arising at arbitrarily late steps (Web.Census.arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom); without merges, with at most B formations active from some step on, arising at arbitrarily late steps needs ceasing at arbitrarily late steps (Web.Census.ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom). Each condition is needed: in Tandem formations t and t + 1 are active at step t; read with each continuing only itself, one arises and one ceases across every step (Tandem.kept); read as budding, the later continuing as itself and as the new formation and the earlier continued by none, the census holds without merges, one ceases across every step and nothing ever arises (Tandem.budding); read as joining, both continuing as the later one, at most two are active without splits, one arises across every step and nothing ever ceases (Tandem.joining). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 延续关系是读法：哪个形成延续哪个由读法给出（同 identity-across-steps），本结果对每个读法成立，不说哪一个是同一。
hypotheses.en: The continuation is a reading: which formation continues which is given by the reading (as in identity-across-steps); the result holds for every reading and does not say which one is identity.

hypotheses.zh: 普查：每步活跃的形成被不重复地列出。活动、延续以及“是否延续某个活跃形成”可判定，是定理的假设，不是公理；后两者由普查与可判定的延续给出（Census.decideContinues、Census.decideContinued）。
hypotheses.en: A census: the formations active at each step are listed, each once. Decided activity, a decided continuation and decided ‘continues some active formation’ are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms; the latter two follow from the census and a decided continuation (Census.decideContinues, Census.decideContinued).

hypotheses.zh: 有界的一半另需从某步起至多 B 个形成活跃。
hypotheses.en: The bounded half also needs at most B formations active from some step on.

correspondence.zh: identity-across-steps 表明，追随形成的读法（生起、不息）依赖谁延续谁，而计数（更多）不依赖。本结果说明普查定律在谁延续谁改变时怎样保持：止息需要生起这一半在每个没有分裂的读法下保持，生起需要止息（计数有界时）这一半在每个没有合并的读法下保持；能抹去生起的恰是分裂，能抹去止息的恰是合并（Tandem）。作者的读法（AI 论证）：同一个展开读出的生起与止息随读法而变，但不能任意变：在没有分裂、没有合并的读法之间，两者的差恰是活跃者数目的变化。这是活动的计数；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）；它也不评价生起或止息；萌出与合并在生物中有其例（分裂繁殖、融合），那是应用，不是定理的内容。
correspondence.en: identity-across-steps shows that readings following a formation (arising, unceasing generation) depend on who continues whom, while the count (more) does not. This result says how the census laws hold as who continues whom changes: the half in which ceasing needs arising holds under every reading without splits, and the half in which arising needs ceasing (under a bounded count) under every reading without merges; what can remove arising is exactly a split, and what can remove ceasing exactly a merge (Tandem). The author's reading (an AI argument): the arising and ceasing read of one unfolding change with the reading, but not arbitrarily: between readings without splits or merges, their difference is exactly the change in the number active. This is a count of activity; whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference); it evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; budding and merging have biological cases (fission, fusion), which are applications, not the content of the theorems.

detail.zh: 复用延续关系、在延续下生起（Continues、ArisesFrom、UnceasingFrom）、没有分裂（NoSplit）、arisesFrom_self 与 Census.decideContinues。
detail.en: Reuses continuations, arising under a continuation (Continues, ArisesFrom, UnceasingFrom), no split (NoSplit), arisesFrom_self and Census.decideContinues.

output.zh: 延续关系与其下的生起；没有分裂时更多迫使生起。
output.en: Continuations and arising under them; without splits, more forces arising.

input.zh: 延续下的止息、合并与普查的平衡。
input.en: Ceasing and merging under a continuation, and the census balance under it.

conditions.zh: 普查；活动与延续可判定。
conditions.en: A census; decided activity and continuation.

detail.zh: 复用标记的计数（marks_le_of_sub、mark_add_not、total_congr_on）与平衡的累加形式（balance_over_stretch 的不等式版本）。
detail.en: Reuses counting by marks (marks_le_of_sub, mark_add_not, total_congr_on) and the stretch form of the balance (balance_over_stretch, here as inequalities).

output.zh: 每个形成只延续自身时的普查平衡（Listed.across）。
output.en: The census balance with each formation continuing only itself (Listed.across).

input.zh: 任一延续下的平衡，分两半。
input.en: The balance under any continuation, in two halves.

detail.zh: 推广 Web.arising_of_ceasing 到每个没有分裂的延续。
detail.en: Generalizes Web.arising_of_ceasing to every continuation without splits.

output.zh: 普查之下止息复现需要生起复现。
output.en: Under a census, ceasing recurring needs arising recurring.

input.zh: 同一规律在每个没有分裂的延续下。
input.en: The same law under every continuation without splits.

detail.zh: 推广有界定律（Web.ceasing_of_arising）到每个没有合并的延续。
detail.en: Generalizes the bounded law (Web.ceasing_of_arising) to every continuation without merges.

output.zh: 计数有界时生起复现需要止息复现。
output.en: Under a bounded count, arising recurring needs ceasing recurring.

input.zh: 同一规律在每个没有合并的延续下。
input.en: The same law under every continuation without merges.

conditions.zh: 没有合并；从某步起至多 B 个活跃。
conditions.en: No merge; at most B active from some step on.

detail.zh: 复用普查（Web.Census）、不重复列表（Distinct）与列表上的判定（decideSome）。
detail.en: Reuses the census (Web.Census), lists without repetition (Distinct) and decision over a list (decideSome).

detail.zh: 计划 P32：普查定律推到每个延续关系；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P32: the census laws carried to every continuation; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 静止定理用名字规定的同一读止息；在没有分裂的延续下，止息需要生起这一半仍成立。
detail.en: The rest theorem reads ceasing under the identity the names stipulate; under a continuation without splits the half in which ceasing needs arising still holds.

detail.zh: 规律 2 的覆盖列表形式（Covers.not_not_coming_from）在延续之下的读法：Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered。两者共用 not_not_all（为此移入 Becoming.Population），其余证明不互相引用。
detail.en: The continuation reading of law 2's covering-list form (Covers.not_not_coming_from): Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered. They share not_not_all (moved into Becoming.Population for this); otherwise neither proof cites the other.

detail.zh: Tandem.budding：普查成立、没有合并，只缺没有分裂，止息复现而从不生起；Tandem.joining：至多两个活跃、没有分裂，只缺没有合并，生起复现而从不止息。
detail.en: Tandem.budding: a census without merges, lacking only no split, ceasing recurring with nothing ever arising; Tandem.joining: at most two active without splits, lacking only no merge, arising recurring with nothing ever ceasing.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与每步有限的活动陈述；要求活动与延续可判定（定理的假设）；延续关系由读法给出，不说哪一个是同一；平衡是计数，不是机制，不说哪个形成生起或止息；整段上没有分裂与没有合并只是充分条件；形成的类、任期与侵蚀在延续下没有陈述；不评价生起或止息；名称（CeasesFrom、NoMerge、Tandem）是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and activity finite at each step; needs decided activity and continuation (hypotheses of the theorems); the continuation is given by a reading, and which one is identity is not said; the balance is a count, not a mechanism, and says not which formation arises or ceases; over a run, no split and no merge are only sufficient; formation classes, tenure and undermining under a continuation are not stated; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; the names (CeasesFrom, NoMerge, Tandem) are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose.

next_delta.zh: 反方向也只用一个覆盖列表（P61b）：一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者、自那步起不合并、生起于延续之下复现时，不再存在于延续之下不会自某步起停止（Web.ceasingFrom_not_stopping_covered）；不用普查，不用判定。两个方向的确切存在形式仍需在每步后列出活跃者；延续之下只用一个覆盖列表（P61）：一个列表覆盖第 M 步的活跃者、自 M 起不分裂、不再存在于延续之下复现时，自 M 起有生起这一点不被否定（Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered）；有任意晚的覆盖列表时，生起不会自某步起停止（Web.arisingFrom_not_stopping_covered）；不用普查，不用判定。反方向（生起复现需要不再存在复现）以覆盖列表加界的形式，以及得到确切的存在形式所需的判定，仍开放；对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 Web.Census.balanceFrom_at、balanceFrom_eq_at、arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom_from、ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom_from（P50），局部条件写在规律之内：一步的平衡只用该步两端的列出与该步的不分裂、不合并；复现定律只用某步以后各步的列出、不分裂（或不合并与有界）；Web.Census.balanceFrom、Web.Census.arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom、Web.Census.ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom是它们的推论；形成的类、任期与侵蚀在延续下的读法；整段上对延续关系的条件（单步的刻画见 identity-across-steps）；带比率的版本；名称（Ren）。
next_delta.en: The converse from one covering list too (P61b): where one list covers the active formations from some step on, nothing merges from that step on, and arising under the continuation recurs, ceasing under it does not stop from any step on (Web.ceasingFrom_not_stopping_covered); no census, no decision. The exact existential forms of both directions still need listings after each step; under a continuation from one covering list (P61): where a list covers the active formations at step M, nothing splits from M on, and ceasing under the continuation recurs, it is not refuted that something arises from M on (Web.not_not_arisingFrom_covered); with covering lists at arbitrarily late steps, arising does not stop (Web.arisingFrom_not_stopping_covered); no census, no decision. The converse (arising recurring needs ceasing recurring) from covering lists with a bound, and the decision needed for the exact existential form, remain open; the exact restatement for every world is this record's Web.Census.balanceFrom_at, balanceFrom_eq_at, arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom_from, ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom_from (P50), the local condition inside the law: the balance across a step uses only the listings at its two ends and that step's splits and merges; the recurrence laws use only the listing, no split (or no merge and the bound) from some step on; Web.Census.balanceFrom, Web.Census.arisingFrom_of_ceasingFrom, Web.Census.ceasingFrom_of_arisingFrom are their corollaries; formation classes, tenure and undermining read under a continuation; conditions on continuations over a run (the step characterization is in identity-across-steps); a version with rates; names (Ren).
